title: Interpretation.
bodyText: Nothing in this part shall be construed to abrogate or affect the provisions of any lawful ordinance or regulation which are more restrictive than this part.
bodyHtml: §264-89  Interpretation.  Nothing in this part shall be construed to abrogate or affect the provisions of any lawful ordinance or regulation which are more restrictive than this part. [L 1966, c 46, pt of §2; HRS §264-89]
